name: customer-win-back
description: Every week, finds customers who have not ordered in a while and drafts a personal email to bring them back, based on what they bought. Nothing is sent until you approve it.

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Customers whose last order was a set number of days ago and who accept marketing email

howItWorks.label: Drafts
howItWorks.text: A short personal email for each, based on what they bought before

howItWorks.label: Sends
howItWorks.text: With Resend, or through your Klaviyo flow, only after you approve

howItWorks.label: Remembers
howItWorks.text: Who was emailed, so nobody hears from you twice within the cooldown

plugins.reason: Sets the win-back date on the customer's profile so your Klaviyo flow sends it, with Klaviyo's own consent and unsubscribe handling

data.description: The customer's first name, for the greeting
Whether the customer agreed to receive marketing email
The customer who placed the order
What they bought (product and quantity), to make the email personal
When the customer was last sent a win-back email, if the project keeps it

parameters.label: Days since last order
parameters.description: Customers whose last order is at least this old

parameters.label: Ignore after (days)
parameters.description: Customers gone longer than this are left alone

parameters.label: Cooldown (days)
parameters.description: Never email the same customer again within this many days

parameters.label: Emails per run
parameters.description: The most customers drafted in one run; the rest wait for next week

parameters.label: The offer
parameters.description: What the email may offer, e.g. "free shipping on the next order"; it never invents one
